freshInspection.objective: Verify current security-relevant persistence constraints, tenant/RBAC integrity, migrations/indexes and determine whether a causal schema/backfill gap exists for N8.11.
observedPersistenceControls: AppDbContext exposes UsuarioEmpresas and RolPermisos and applies all IEntityTypeConfiguration mappings from the Infrastructure assembly through ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly.

UsuarioEmpresa persistence requires UsuarioId, EmpresaId and RolId, restricts FK deletes, enforces unique membership per UsuarioId+EmpresaId, and indexes EmpresaId+RolId+Activo for scoped authorization lookup.
RolPermiso persistence requires RolId and PermisoId, restricts FK deletes, and enforces uniqueness for each role-permission relation.

Current migration set contains no new N8.11 security schema migration because the current relational tenant/RBAC constraints are already represented in the model; no evidence of a current-standard security backfill requirement was found.
freshInspection.historicalEvidenceContextOnly: Historical N8.11.C also concluded DB_MIG N/A; this fresh review does not use that status as authority.
freshInspection.causalConclusion: No security schema delta, migration, backfill or production database write is causally required at N8.11.C. The demonstrated remaining risks are runtime/API/configuration/testing concerns already routed to N8.11.D/F/G.
freshInspection.postcheck: Current EF mappings retain tenant membership and role-permission uniqueness/FK constraints; subsequent API/security tests must exercise enforcement through real application paths.
